title: Limited Generalizability in Argument Mining: State-Of-The-Art Models Learn Datasets, Not Arguments

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model generalization across 17 different argument mining benchmark datasets in a pairwise transfer learning setup to show performance degradation on out-of-distribution data.

Applying controlled input manipulation by systematically removing stop words, functional words, and discourse markers to demonstrate models' over-reliance on topic-specific content words (shortcuts) rather than true argumentative structure.
